reviewed_by: lead source-to-binary review against evidence sheet sections 13.8 and 17.4
review_scope: QTask_AllocateEvent full body including the exhaustion branch

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Entry 0x004017C0 recovered exactly by Binary Ninja and radare2 at extent 0x004017C0-0x0040180C.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: bn=6/7 r2=6/7, CFG similarity 1.000, above the 0.85 threshold.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: One argument, read as a word at [esp+4] and stored as the 16-bit record value word; no other argument slot is read.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Only callee is Debug_Error 0x004AF7B0 on exhaustion. Side effects are the three record-field writes at +2, +0 (word) and +3 in table 0x0054F930, and no others.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: First id 0x20, stride 6, table end 0x54FF26, exhaustion string 0x5361A8 - all reproduced exactly.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: Integer-only routine; no floating point instruction.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: 6-byte records; +0 word is written with one 16-bit store at an even offset; +2 and +3 are single bytes; table extent 0x5F4 bytes (254 records) matches the clear loop bound.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Success returns the dword id in EAX (inc eax from 0x20). The single error path pushes the string, calls Debug_Error and jumps to itself at 0x004017E8, never returning; both reproduced.

limitations: Source-to-binary and emitted-code review only. No runtime observation exists because the startup boundary stops execution before this native, so a runtime contract cannot be authored honestly and the VERIFIED threshold remains out of reach by design rather than by neglect.
